global.footer_blurb: Premium ground handling, luxury transfers and tailored tours across Victoria Falls, Hwange, Kasane and Livingstone.

home.intro_text:
Every journey with Signature Africa is crafted to be more than just a transfer. It's defined by comfort, reliability and personal attention, delivered through a fleet of luxury vehicles, expert driver-guides and bespoke tour options.

Our knowledgeable guides are not just drivers, but storytellers who bring each destination to life — where excellence is the standard and every guest experience is a true ‘WOW’ moment.
home.feature2_text: Private Pilatus PC-12 charter flights throughout Zimbabwe and across the Southern African region, plus curated day trips to Hwange, Matopos and Great Zimbabwe.
home.feature1_text: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. Accompanied by a knowledgeable guide, discover the rich history and vibrant ecosystems surrounding Mosi-a-Tunya, ‘The Smoke That Thunders.’
home.hero_text: Premium ground handling for leisure and corporate travellers exploring Victoria Falls, Hwange, Kasane and Livingstone. Seamless cross-border transfers and bespoke tours, delivered with comfort, reliability and personal attention.
home.cta_heading: Ready For Your Signature Africa Experience?
home.cta_text: Tell us your dates and destinations — we'll take care of the rest.

transfers.intro_text:
Choose from our private or scheduled transfer options for convenient and flexible travel. Our drivers are not only highly experienced but also qualified professional tour guides, ready to share their knowledge along the way.

We uphold the highest standards of safety and comfort through routine maintenance and rigorous vehicle checks, ensuring every journey is smooth, secure and stress-free.
transfers.r5_text: Effortlessly travel from Kasane Airport to your destination, with timely pickups and drop-offs into Botswana.
transfers.r4_text: Experience smooth transfers from Livingstone Airport to your chosen location. Prompt, courteous drivers ensure you reach your destination safely.
transfers.r3_text: Travel comfortably to Hwange Main Camp with our dedicated transfer service — a safe, pleasant journey through the stunning landscapes of Hwange National Park.
transfers.r2_text: Enjoy hassle-free transfers within Victoria Falls town, whether you're heading to attractions, dining spots or shopping areas — promptly and comfortably.
transfers.r1_text: Seamlessly connect from Victoria Falls Airport to your destination. Our professional drivers greet you on arrival, assist with your luggage, and ensure a stress-free journey to your accommodation.
transfers.hero_text: From the comfort of our air-conditioned vehicles to the exceptional quality of service, every Signature Africa transfer is an elevated travel experience.

fleet.hero_text: A vehicle for every party size, every terrain and every occasion — each one maintained to the highest standards of safety and comfort.
fleet.v1_text: Experience ultimate luxury with our Ineos Grenadier, a 4-seater Signature Class vehicle available for daily hire. Ideal for discerning travellers, it offers unmatched comfort, advanced features and a smooth ride for exclusive journeys.
fleet.v2_text: The Toyota Majesty is a high-end executive MPV that trades passenger capacity for first-class luxury — a limousine-like experience with premium quilted leather, motorised ottomans and advanced safety tech, making it the ideal choice for VIP transport and elite corporate travel.
fleet.v3_text: Our Toyota Quantums are spacious transfer vehicles seating 6 to 13, perfect for small to medium-sized groups, with ample legroom and advanced safety features for a comfortable, enjoyable journey.
fleet.v4_text: Ideal for larger groups, the Toyota Hiace offers comfortable seating for up to 13 passengers — everyone travels together in comfort and safety.
fleet.v5_text: The Hino Coaster is our premier solution for larger-scale transport, accommodating up to 20 passengers with ease. This meticulously maintained vehicle ensures your entire party travels in total comfort and safety.
fleet.v6_text: Our 28-seater King Long Coach is designed for larger groups seeking luxury and comfort — a premium travel experience for tours, corporate events and group excursions.

tours.adventures_text: White Water Rafting · Bungee Jumping · Bridge Slide · Bridge Swing · Gorge Swing · Zipline · Flying Fox · Canopy Tour
tours.t5_text: Delve into the vibrant township areas near Victoria Falls, discovering the resilience and community spirit that define township living.
tours.t4_text: A captivating journey through a vibrant rural village near Victoria Falls, led by a warm community member — an authentic look into Zimbabwean village life, traditions and customs.
tours.t3_text: Elevate your adventure with breath-taking helicopter tours. Choose a 12-minute scenic flight over the Falls, or a 25-minute flight over the wildlife of Zambezi National Park.
tours.t1_name: Guided Tour Of The Victoria Falls
tours.t2_text: A boat ride to Livingstone Island, insights into its history, the thrill of Devil's Pool or Angel's Pool, followed by a luxurious 5-star meal above the Falls.
tours.t1_text: Embark on a guided walking tour of Victoria Falls — a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. Discover the rich history, geological marvels and vibrant ecosystems surrounding Mosi-a-Tunya, ‘The Smoke That Thunders.’
tours.hero_text: From guided walks along the Smoke That Thunders to helicopter flights, thrilling adventures and authentic community visits.

aviation.intro_text: We can organise private charter flights throughout Zimbabwe and extending to the entire Southern African region — a fast, flexible way to reach remote camps, day-trip destinations and cross-border airstrips.
aviation.hero_text: Private charter flights throughout Zimbabwe, extending to the entire Southern African region — flown aboard a 2024 Pilatus PC-12 NGX.
aviation.d3_text: A flight to Masvingo for a guided tour of the Great Zimbabwe Ruins, a cultural village visit, a scenic drive around Masvingo Dam, and rock painting exploration.
aviation.d2_text: A flight to Bulawayo for the National Rail Museum, a guided visit to Matopos National Park, Rhodes Grave, white rhino tracking, cave paintings and a gourmet lunch.
aviation.d1_text: An early morning flight from Victoria Falls into Hwange National Park for a full day game drive, a picnic-style lunch, and a sundowner over the savannah.
aviation.vip_text: Executive handling on the ground, wherever you land.
aviation.vip_i1_text: Tarmac escorts across regional hubs, with priority handling and luggage assistance.
aviation.vip_i2_text: Discreet, comfortable terminal facilities away from the main commercial concourse.
aviation.vip_i3_text: Priority clearance arranged ahead of your arrival or departure.
aviation.charter_i1_text: Short scenic flights and camp-to-camp hops across the region's safari circuits.
aviation.charter_i2_text: Private charters for business travel, family groups or special occasions.
aviation.dest_text: Regional connections across East and Southern Africa, from major hubs to remote bush airstrips.
aviation.dest_zw: Zimbabwe — Victoria Falls (VFA), Mana Pools, Hwange, Kariba
aviation.dest_za: South Africa — Johannesburg (JNB), Cape Town (CPT), Kruger (MQP/SZK)
aviation.dest_zm: Zambia — Livingstone (LVI), Lower Zambezi, South Luangwa

contact.hero_text: We hope you've found what you're looking for. If you need any additional information, reach out to us directly — we usually reply the same day.

victoria_falls.hero_text: From VIP airport meet & greet to adrenaline on the Zambezi, every way to experience the Smoke That Thunders.
victoria_falls.intro_text: Signature Africa's Victoria Falls operation covers every touchpoint of your visit — private transfers, airside VIP handling, and a full calendar of guided tours, adrenaline activities and river cruises.
victoria_falls.g1_text: Private, professional transport from the moment you land to the moment you check in.
victoria_falls.g1_i1_text: Airside welcome for private charters, with luggage assistance and fast-track arrival and departure.
victoria_falls.g1_i2_text: Seamless connections between VFA and your accommodation, with professional driver-guides.
victoria_falls.g1_i3_text: Direct transfers to Kasane, Livingstone or Maun, handling border formalities along the way.
victoria_falls.g1_i4_text: Comfortable, on-demand transport between lodges, hotels and the town centre.
victoria_falls.g1_i5_name: Private Minibus & Luxury SUV Fleet Hire
victoria_falls.g1_i5_text: Self-drive or chauffeured hire from our luxury SUV and minibus fleet.
victoria_falls.g2_text: See the Falls, the gorges and the wildlife below from a Bell JetRanger — the only way to take in the full scale of Mosi-a-Tunya.
victoria_falls.g2_i1_text: A scenic loop directly over the Falls and gorges — the classic Victoria Falls helicopter flight.
victoria_falls.g2_i2_text: An extended route over the Falls, the Batoka Gorge and the wildlife of Zambezi National Park.
victoria_falls.g2_i3_text: Exclusive charters for private groups, photography flights or executive transfers.
victoria_falls.g3_text: The Batoka Gorge is one of the world's great adventure playgrounds — Grade 5 rapids, a 111m gorge swing, and Africa's highest bungee jump.
victoria_falls.g3_i1_text: 111 metres of freefall from the historic Victoria Falls Bridge, suspended between Zimbabwe and Zambia.
victoria_falls.g3_i2_text: A gentler alternative to the bungee, with the same spectacular gorge and bridge views.
victoria_falls.g3_i3_text: Freefall into the Batoka Gorge on the swing, or fly across it at speed on the zip line.
victoria_falls.g3_i4_text: Half or full day rafting through Grade 3–5 rapids on one of the world's premier white water rivers.
victoria_falls.g4_text: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World, best explored on foot with a knowledgeable local guide.
victoria_falls.g4_i1_text: A walking tour through the rainforest viewpoints, with insight into the Falls' history, geology and ecosystems.
victoria_falls.g4_i2_text: An exclusive, unhurried version of the rainforest tour for private groups and families.
victoria_falls.g5_text: Drift past pods of hippo and grazing elephant on a signature sunset cruise along the mighty Zambezi River.
victoria_falls.g5_i1_text: Sundowners on the Zambezi as the sky turns gold over the river — snacks and drinks included.
victoria_falls.g5_i2_text: An evening cruise with a full dinner service and cocktail bar on board.
victoria_falls.g5_i3_text: Exclusive use of the boat for private celebrations, proposals or corporate events.
victoria_falls.g6_text: A handful of only-in-Victoria-Falls experiences, from a traditional Boma dinner to gentle time with rescued elephants.
victoria_falls.e1_text: A traditional African feast with live drumming, dancers and a fire-lit boma setting — an unforgettable Victoria Falls evening.
victoria_falls.e2_text: Gentle, guided interaction with rescued and rehabilitated elephants in their natural bush environment.
victoria_falls.e3_text: A guided walk through a local Victoria Falls township — markets, a beer garden, and genuine community life.

livingstone.hero_text: Devil's Pool, Livingstone Island and the Zambian side of the Falls — VIP handling and unforgettable experiences across the border.
livingstone.intro_heading: The Zambian Side Of The Smoke
livingstone.intro_text: From tarmac welcomes at Harry Mwanga Nkumbula International Airport to a swim at the edge of the Falls on Livingstone Island, our Zambia operation mirrors the same VIP standard as Victoria Falls.
livingstone.g1_text: Priority handling on arrival, and comfortable transfers to your lodge or across the border.
livingstone.g1_i1_text: Tarmac welcome at Harry Mwanga Nkumbula International Airport, with priority immigration support.
livingstone.g1_i2_name: Harry Mwanga Nkumbula International Airport (LVI) Transfers
livingstone.g1_i2_text: Direct transfers between LVI and your accommodation in Livingstone.
livingstone.g1_i3_name: Kazungula & Victoria Falls Border Crossing Transfers
livingstone.g1_i3_text: Cross-border transfers with full assistance through immigration and customs formalities.
livingstone.g1_i4_text: On-demand chauffeured transport between lodges, the town centre and key attractions.
livingstone.g2_text: A once-in-a-lifetime swim at the very lip of Victoria Falls, only accessible from the Zambian side.
livingstone.g2_i1_text: An early boat transfer to Livingstone Island with breakfast, before the day's crowds arrive.
livingstone.g2_i2_name: Livingstone Island High Tea / Lunch & Devil's Pool Swim
livingstone.g2_i2_text: A guided swim in Devil's Pool followed by high tea or a plated lunch overlooking the Falls.
livingstone.g2_i3_name: Angel's Pool Swim (Seasonal Low Water Alternative)
livingstone.g2_i3_text: A gentler pool-edge swim available during lower water months, when Devil's Pool isn't accessible.
livingstone.g3_text: Fine dining alongside a herd of rescued elephants at their riverside sanctuary.
livingstone.g3_i1_name: Elephant Cafe Fine Dining & Sanctuary Experience
livingstone.g3_i1_text: A guided visit to the sanctuary followed by a plated meal in the company of the resident elephant herd.
livingstone.g3_i2_text: A scenic speedboat transfer along the Zambezi combined with the Elephant Cafe dining experience.
livingstone.g4_text: The same spectacular aerial views of the Falls, departing from the Zambian side.
livingstone.g4_i1_name: Livingstone Victoria Falls Helicopter Scenic Flight
livingstone.g4_i1_text: A scenic loop over the Falls and gorges, departing from Livingstone.
livingstone.g4_i2_text: An extended flight over both the Falls and the dramatic Batoka Gorge below.
livingstone.g5_text: Guided time in Livingstone's living history and community life, beyond the riverfront lodges.
livingstone.g5_i1_text: A guided visit to the traditional Mukuni village, home to the local Leya people.
livingstone.g5_i2_text: A tour through Zambia's oldest and largest museum, followed by a drive through historic Livingstone.
livingstone.g5_i3_text: A guided walk through Livingstone's largest local market for crafts, produce and everyday Zambian life.

kasane.hero_text: Gateway to Chobe National Park — VIP airport handling and unforgettable game-viewing on the Chobe River.
kasane.intro_heading: Where The Rivers Meet The Wild
kasane.intro_text: Kasane sits at the confluence of the Chobe and Zambezi rivers, and at the entrance to Chobe National Park — home to one of Africa's largest elephant populations. We handle every arrival detail and the game-viewing that follows.
kasane.g1_text: VIP handling at Kasane Airport and seamless transfers into the park or across the border.
kasane.g1_i1_text: Airside escort at Kasane Airport, with luggage handling and VIP customs clearance.
kasane.g1_i2_text: Direct transfers between Kasane Airport and your lodge or camp.
kasane.g1_i3_name: Cross-Border Transfers (Kasane To Victoria Falls / Livingstone)
kasane.g1_i3_text: Comfortable cross-border transfers with full assistance through immigration.
kasane.g1_i4_text: Transport between Kasane's lodges, camps and the town centre.
kasane.g2_text: A morning or sunset boat safari along the Chobe River, famous for its dense elephant and hippo populations.
kasane.g2_i1_name: Chobe River Morning / Sunset Boat Safari
kasane.g2_i1_text: A guided boat cruise along the Chobe River, with close-up wildlife viewing from the water.
kasane.g2_i2_text: A guided game drive through Chobe National Park in search of elephant, buffalo, lion and more.
kasane.g3_text: A complete day combining game drive, river cruise and lunch, or a scenic day trip across the border to Victoria Falls.
kasane.g3_i1_text: A full day combining a Chobe game drive, a Chobe River cruise, and lunch — the complete Chobe experience.
kasane.g3_i2_name: Kasane To Victoria Falls Day Trip
kasane.g3_i2_text: A guided day trip from Kasane across the border to explore Victoria Falls.
